digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and guide system
propositions: Author-facing documentation must explain that risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after slow codified delivery loops must be named and proved out-of-loop before codification.
T15 guidance must specify that fast proof is either a local run or a manual probe against the real target, with cleanup scoped only to resources created by the throwaway experiment.

The packaged guide rendering, criterion-pins manifest, and hand-authored overlay enumeration must be updated from T1–T12 / 32 criteria to T1–T15 / 44 criteria to remain in sync with validated registry.
Documentation and registry module docstrings must remain stack-agnostic and not hardcode product-specific mechanisms like Terraform or Docker.
